correctness.rationale: Nonzero quadratic residues modulo 13 give exactly the 13 open neighborhoods. Two independent exhaustive face-membership methods agree on 598 nonempty faces, vector (13,78,221,195,78,13); each vertex link in the graph is a C6. A complete stored certificate lists 286 disjoint codimension-one face pairs and a topological ordering of all 598 vertices in the directed face-poset Hasse diagram, strictly respecting all 2067 directed incidences. Thus the matching is acyclic. It leaves one critical 0-cell and 25 critical 2-cells, so Forman Morse theory gives precisely a wedge of 25 S2 integrally. Rebuilt modular boundary ranks (12,66,130,65,13) across primes 2,3,5,7 independently corroborate the cell count; they are not used as integral proof. All claims restrict to this one finite open-neighborhood complex.

value.rationale: The smallest prime Paley graph beyond valency four is a canonical, symmetric, locally hexagonal graph whose graph topology sits in the established classification of locally C6 graphs. Determining the full integral homotopy type of its five-dimensional ordinary neighborhood complex, and providing an explicit perfect Morse matching to 25 two-cells, supplies a motivated exact natural invariant beyond the low-valency theorems. The contrast with the published Paley17 three-torsion case is mathematically informative; no claim of a general transition or of a broad theorem is made.
